scope: Frozen 32-case dev only; no Official-100 outcomes may select a weight.

selection_rule.primary: Choose the admissible weight with the lowest mean relative legalized cost across seeds, then break ties by mean relative V_rel.
admissibility: mean relative cost is below zero against group=1.0
mean relative V_rel is below zero against group=1.0
pooled V_rel is not worse than zero
legalized feasible fraction equals 1.0 for every seed and arm
selection_rule.stop_rule: If no non-baseline weight is admissible, retain group=1.0 or group=2.0 only as a matched control recipe and do not attribute its gain to the model.
